label: Arista 7280SR2-48YC6 / 7280SR2A-48YC6 (48x 1/10/25G SFP, 6x 100G QSFP)
description: Arista 7280SR2-48YC6 - 1RU deep-buffer switch router (7280R2): 48x 1/10/25G SFP (Ethernet1-48, 25G or 10G/1G configurable in groups of 4) plus 6x 100G QSFP (Ethernet49-54) that also take 40G or break out to 25G/10G. 3.6 Tbps, 8 GB buffer.
notes: Arista 7280R data sheet, 'Arista 7280SR2A-48YC6 and 7280SR2-48YC6' bullet: "7280SR2A-48YC6 and 7280SR2-48YC6: 48 port 25GbE SFP and 6 ports 100GbE" / "Offers 48 wire speed 1/10/25G SFP ports with FC and RS FEC" / "SFP ports offer 25G or 10G/1G speeds configurable in groups of 4" / "Six 100G QSFP ports allow choice of 6 x 100GbE, 24x 25GbE, 6x 40GbE, or 24x 10GbE" / "3.6Tbps of wire speed performance with 8GB of buffer". Hence SFP28 cages on Ethernet1-48 with 1/10/25G caps and QSFP28 on Ethernet49-54. The 4-port grouping the sheet mentions is a speed-step constraint, not an extra port or cage, so it is not modelled as separate interfaces. The AlgoMatch sibling 7280SR2A-48YC6 shares one bullet and one comparison column with this SKU - it differs in the policy engine, not in its ports - so it is an alias rather than a second spec. The comparison table flags both End of Sale (E).
